    CpSatSolver<S>
    CpSatSolver.explainInfeasibility(boolean explain)
    When the model turns out infeasible, solves it once more with its main constraint groups labeled (for example a shift's staffing, an operation's deadline, the pieces of one type) and reports the labels of a set of groups that cannot hold together in SolveDiagnostics.infeasibilityReasons().
    CpSatSolver<S>
    CpSatSolver.exportModel(Path file)
    Writes the CP-SAT model to file just before each search, for inspection or for reproducing a solve outside this library.
    CpSatSolver<S>
    CpSatSolver.onSolution(Consumer<S> listener)
    Registers a listener invoked for every improving intermediate solution found during the search.
    CpSatSolver<S>
    CpSatSolver.seed(int randomSeed)
    Sets the random seed.
    CpSatSolver<S>
    CpSatProblem.solver()
    Returns a fresh CpSatSolver bound to this problem.
    CpSatSolver<S>
